verdict.rationale: Kimi's API spec lists a batches endpoint for submitting many requests together. Kimi Code documents multi-file refactoring and whole-project refactoring, and the file API supports multi-file question answering. All of these are thin mentions, so bulk semantics, limits and workflows are unproven. Missing for 10: documented Batch API behavior (job submission, status, results, limits), explicit bulk-action workflows in the assistant or agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Best for large codebase analysis, multi-file refactoring, and long-document processing.
